proposition_chain.statement: The analysis combines four data sources: Capital IQ earnings-call transcripts (US public firms, 2002-2018, parsed to speaker role and presentation-vs-Q&A segment); quarterly Compustat North America fundamentals (matched as the most recent fiscal quarter ending on or before the call); CRSP daily and IBES earnings records (supplying the stock-return, market-return, and earnings-surprise controls the eq-4 decomposition requires); and SDC M&A records (announcement date, completion/withdrawal date, and cash-vs-stock payment composition).
proposition_chain.reason: Every downstream number originates in one of these four sources; the data-provenance premise the whole section leans on, and Section 2 deferred it here.
evidence: variable_ledger.json UncResCEO.upstream (Capital IQ + LM dict; CRSP/IBES feed eq-4 StockRet/MarketRet/EPSgrowth/SurpDec)

proposition_chain.statement: The sources are linked across identifier systems: SDC keys deals by the acquirer's six-digit CUSIP while the call panel is keyed by Compustat firm identifier (gvkey), so deals are joined to calls through the acquirer six-digit CUSIP via the CRSP-Compustat link table (the master-sample manifest).
proposition_chain.reason: The cash/stock-acquirer classification and the event clock exist only because SDC deals are matched to the call panel; record linkage is a material researcher degree of freedom that must be disclosed, not assumed.
evidence: variable_ledger.json tab:empire_building_did design.firm_link ('SDC acquirer 6-digit CUSIP -> gvkey via master_sample_manifest.parquet')

proposition_chain.statement: The uncertainty measures are built in-house: each call is tokenized and the Loughran-McDonald uncertainty-word share computed separately by speaker and segment; the CEO's Q&A share UncAnsCEO is the input the Section 2.3 DWZ equation-4 first stage (estimated on our sample) residualizes into UncResCEO. This is the CONSTRUCTION MECHANIC only; the equation and the definition/justification of UncResCEO live in Section 2.3 and are not re-derived.
proposition_chain.reason: 2.3 defines UncResCEO and writes eq-4 but explicitly defers tokenize/match mechanics to 3.1; 3.1 must supply those mechanics (and the by-speaker-by-segment computation) without re-deriving eq-4 or re-justifying the residual (boundary against 2.3 turf).

proposition_chain.statement: The estimation samples are built in three layers: (a) the base call panel (every matched Capital IQ call of a US public, non-financial, non-utility firm 2002-2018, excluding CEOs with fewer than five calls, for whom no style and hence no residual is estimable); (b) the SDC deal universe (US public acquirer 2002-2018, status in {completed, pending, withdrawn}, known payment composition; >=50%-cash deals form the cash arm, >=50%-stock the stock placebo arm, each firm's first qualifying deal setting its event clock); and (c) design-specific trims (the run-up test drops treated post-announcement quarters; the event studies cap the post-window at four quarters and truncate at the firm's next announcement; the scrutiny validity/channel tests require at least three analyst Q&A turns per call). The >=5-call filter is stated here as a MECHANIC; its selection-THREAT framing is homed in 2.4 P5.5, not re-disclosed here.
proposition_chain.reason: N varies across every results table; without the three-layer logic the reader reads the varying counts as inconsistency rather than as each test keeping only the firms for which its comparison is defined. The boundary keeps the >=5-call selection THREAT in 2.4 P5.5 and only the MECHANIC here.

proposition_chain.statement: Table 1 reports summary statistics for the main estimation sample (anchor sample 88,205 earnings-call observations across 1,884 firms, 2002-2018); N varies by row because each variable is summarized on its anchor panel's complete cases, and the residual UncResCEO is centered near zero with standard deviation 0.3010 (Panel B). Because the residual exists only on the >=5-call, non-financial/non-utility universe, the uncertainty regressions describe a more-covered, larger-firm-skewed set than the cash-ratio regressions, and every table reports its own firm and observation counts.
proposition_chain.reason: Table 1 is the exhibit 3.1 anchors and 2.5-P5 forward-references; the residual SD reported here (Panel B, all-universe 0.3010) is the basis the locked 2.5 prose already uses for its FB percentages and the basis 3.2's economic-magnitude statements should reuse. The coverage-skew disclosure stays a MECHANIC-level note (the THREAT is homed in 2.4 P5.5). N-counts 67,590/27,622 are NOT in this table; they belong to empire_building_did and are disclosed in 3.2.
